segments.title: Depart SFO → London Heathrow
segments.detail: Direct, Economy. 1 carry-on (max 10kg, 56×36×23cm) + 1 personal item only. No checked bags.

segments.title: Land at London Heathrow
segments.summary: Clear passport control → Elizabeth line to central London
segments.detail: Take the Elizabeth line from LHR to Paddington (~30 min, ~£13), then 10-min walk / short Tube to hotel. Contactless card works directly — no Oyster needed.

segments.title: Check in — Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
segments.detail: 8–11 Upper Woburn Place, Camden, WC1H 0JV. Windowless Double Pod (very dark — good for jet-lag sleep). No breakfast included. £100 damage deposit required on arrival by credit card (refunded within 7 days). Free cancellation was until Jun 21. Check-out Jul 1 by 12:00.

pin.name: Four Points Flex by Sheraton London Euston
pin.address: 8-11 Upper Woburn Place, London WC1H 0JV, UK

segments.title: Notting Hill
segments.detail: Elizabeth line one stop from Paddington to Notting Hill Gate (~5 min). Portobello Road antique market runs Mon–Sat (winds down ~5pm — go there first). Pastel terraces on Lansdowne Road, Electric Cinema, independent coffee. Easy decompression after the flight.

segments.title: Dinner — Fallow
segments.detail: One of London's best right now — nose-to-tail British cooking, exceptional cocktails. 2 St James's Market, SW1Y 4AH. ~20 min from Notting Hill Gate by Tube. Save your appetite. Budget ~£80–100 with drinks.

pin.name: Fallow St. James's
pin.address: 2 St James's Market, London SW1Y 4AH, UK

segments.title: Westminster Abbey
segments.detail: Every British monarch since 1066 crowned here. Arrive at 9am opening to beat groups. Allow 90 min. BOOK TIMED ENTRY IN ADVANCE.

segments.title: British Museum
segments.summary: Free · pre-book timed slot · 5 min from hotel
segments.detail: Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies, Elgin Marbles, the Foster Great Court. Allow 2 hrs. Free entry but reserve a timed slot online.

pin.name: The British Museum
pin.address: Great Russell St, London WC1B 3DG, UK

segments.title: Eurostar 9028: London St Pancras → Paris Gare du Nord
segments.detail: 2h 28m direct. Arrive St Pancras 60–90 min early — airport-style passport control + security. Gates close 30 min before departure. COMPLETE ADVANCE PASSENGER INFO (API) BEFORE TRAVEL — required to collect tickets.

segments.title: Check in — Hôtel d'Amiens
segments.detail: 11 Rue des Deux Gares, 75010 Paris. 8-min walk from Gare du Nord. Twin room, ground floor, courtyard view, AC, soundproofed. No breakfast. ~$423 incl. city tax, pay at property. Free cancellation was until Jun 29. Update arrival-time special request to 17:00–18:00. Check-out Jul 3 by 12:00.

pin.name: Hôtel d'Amiens
pin.address: 11 Rue des Deux Gares, 75010 Paris, France

segments.title: First evening in Paris — Canal Saint-Martin
segments.summary: Wine bar + dinner · or Louvre late opening (Wed til 21:45)
segments.detail: Drop bags and explore. The Louvre has late opening Wednesdays until 21:45 if you have energy. Otherwise head to Canal Saint-Martin (15-min walk) for natural wine and small plates.

segments.title: Boulangerie breakfast
segments.summary: Café au lait + pain au chocolat
segments.detail: Find a neighbourhood boulangerie near the hotel. Order standing at the bar like a local.

segments.title: The Louvre
segments.summary: ~€22 · book 9–10am timed entry · open til 18:00 Thu
segments.detail: Closed Tuesdays — Thursday is correct. Book a morning slot. Go straight to the Mona Lisa (Salle 711) before groups. Venus de Milo, Winged Victory. Allow 2.5–3 hrs.

segments.title: Jardin des Tuileries picnic
segments.detail: Grab supplies from a boulangerie and picnic in the gardens between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde.

segments.title: Le Marais & Notre-Dame
segments.summary: Medieval streets + cathedral · free entry, book slot
segments.detail: Walk through the Marais (galleries, falafel on Rue des Rosiers) to Île de la Cité. Notre-Dame reopened Dec 2024 — free entry, reserve a timed slot online to skip the queue.

segments.title: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur
segments.detail: Metro up to Montmartre. Sacré-Cœur (free), street artists on Place du Tertre, terrace dinner with city views at dusk. Budget ~€45–65 for dinner.

pin.name: Basilique du Sacré-Cœur
pin.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris, France

days.label: The Big Travel Day — Paris → Buxton

segments.title: Eurostar 9007: Paris Gare du Nord → London St Pancras
segments.detail: 2h 28m direct. Arrive Gare du Nord by 05:30 for check-in — French passport control + security. This is the most time-critical moment of the trip. Hotel is an 8-min walk from the station.

segments.title: St Pancras → Euston (walk)
segments.detail: Arrive St Pancras 08:30. Walk 12–15 min to Euston. Huge buffer before the 13:13 — have a proper sit-down breakfast. Don't dawdle but no need to rush.

segments.title: Avanti: London Euston → Manchester Piccadilly
segments.summary: Coach E, Seat 33 · arrives 15:19 · ref OT982003
segments.detail: 2h 6m direct. ADVANCE SINGLE — you MUST board this specific 13:13 train. Missing it means buying a new full-price ticket. £43.50.

segments.title: Manchester Piccadilly → Buxton (Northern)
segments.detail: Trains hourly. Aim ~15:15–16:15. Buy at the station machine or Northern app — no advance discount. Tap contactless.

segments.title: Arrive Buxton — check in
segments.detail: Settle in, explore Pavilion Gardens, low-key dinner, early night before the wedding. BOOK ACCOMMODATION — Old Hall Hotel or Palace Hotel & Spa.

segments.title: Morning in Buxton
segments.detail: Explore the spa town. Pavilion Gardens and the restored Crescent are worth a stroll.

pin.name: Buxton Pavilion Gardens
pin.address: St John's Rd, Buxton SK17 6BE, UK

segments.title: Wedding ceremony & reception
segments.summary: Confirm time & venue with the couple
segments.detail: Smart-formal. UK July — pack a light jacket and consider waterproof shoes. Confirm exact timing and venue details.

segments.title: Buxton → Manchester Piccadilly (Northern)
segments.summary: ~1 hr · buy on day · verify Sunday timetable
segments.detail: Leave Buxton ~08:20 to reach Piccadilly ~09:20 for the 09:27 onward train. Northern has Sunday conductor disruption — CHECK nationalrail.co.uk a few days before. Buy at machine.

segments.title: Manchester Piccadilly → London Euston (LNR)
segments.summary: Super Off-Peak · LNR ONLY (not Avanti) · ref TTBMDHRYTQP
segments.detail: Flexible Super Off-Peak Single, valid ONLY on LNR/WMR&TFW services — NOT Avanti. ~2h15–30m via Milton Keynes. £42.90. Aim to be at Euston by ~12:30.

segments.title: Euston → Heathrow T3 (Elizabeth line)
segments.summary: ~10 min walk to Paddington, then ~45 min to T3
segments.detail: Walk to Paddington (~10 min), Elizabeth line direct to Heathrow T3 (~45 min, ~£13). Arrive T3 by ~14:00–14:30 — comfortable buffer before the 18:30 flight.

segments.title: Depart LHR → SFO (VS41)
segments.summary: Virgin Atlantic · arrives SFO 21:25 same day · ref EAU2YY
segments.detail: 10h 55m direct, Economy. Be at T3 3 hours before — by ~15:30 ideally.
